summary: Master the art of customer engagement with our comprehensive training course. Discover omnichannel strategies that drive loyalty and boost sales.
lede: Omnichannel customer engagement strategies help organizations deliver a consistent experience across every customer touchpoint. This course shows professionals how to design, coordinate, and improve interactions across channels so each one supports a clear, connected journey. Participants learn to map touchpoints, clarify the role of each channel, coordinate interactions, and use data to personalize engagement at scale. The practical approach helps leaders connect customer activity with engagement, satisfaction, and lifetime value across campaigns, services, and support.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly influence or manage customer-facing channels and interactions.
audience: Contact center and customer support managers
Branch, retail, or field service leaders
modules: Understanding Your Customer and Their Journey
Service, Support, and Experience Across Channels
Governance, Ways of Working, and Change Management
Roadmapping and Action Planning for Your Organization
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of customer engagement concepts and experience in managing or influencing customer-facing channels.
